sloka: अथापि किम् जीवित मद्य मे वृथा ।त्वया विना च्न्द्रनिभाननप्रभ ।अनुव्रजिष्यामि वनम् त्वयैव गौः ।सुदुर्बला वत्समिवानुकाङ्क्षया ॥२-२०-५४॥
transliteration: athāpi kim jīvita madya me vṛthā ।tvayā vinā cndranibhānanaprabha ।anuvrajiṣyāmi vanam tvayaiva gauḥ ।sudurbalā vatsamivānukāṅkṣayā ॥2-20-54॥

translations.english: What is the use of this life now? What is life without you whose countenance glows like the full Moon? Like a cow emaciated by its search for the calf, I will follow you into the forest.
